Jwt.//Authority: REQUIRED: the OpenID Connect provider whose published keys sign the access tokens; this host's public https URL when it runs NovaCore.Identity.OpenIddict.

Seed.//: SeedOnStartup requires the DB to be migrated. Set the admin password via user-secrets. The admin's permissions apply once 2FA is on (/api/v1/auth/2fa/setup + /enable).

Cache.//PermissionExpiration: How long resolved permissions are cached: the longest a role change takes to reach a signed-in user.

ForwardedHeaders.//: Behind a reverse proxy: its IP addresses (KnownProxies) or CIDR networks (KnownIPNetworks). Their X-Forwarded-For and X-Forwarded-Proto then set the client address and scheme; empty applies nobody's.
